mission.goal: Implement consequential remaining functionality after reading the comprehensive plan and beads; publish meaningful checkpoints directly to main through GitHub without PRs.
bead_scope: VIT-023 / fss-vit023-review-export-w8aai: local screened review only
FSS-139 / fss-x4a.14.10: bounded native model operator support

interrupted_recording_review: Distinct ADP-RTSP-GAPPED-CATALOG-001 retained-origin profile for complete ordered catalog or page-list selections, exposed by fss-import-rtsp --decode-gaps preserve.
Separate request, identity, proof and CLI-approval domains; explicit reject and the omitted default preserve old continuous request/preview/approval bytes.
Replay all native catalogs and original packet windows; preserve tfdt, DTS, PTS, durations and original objects; normalize only derived fragment sequence numbers.
Derive discontinuity positions independently from catalog descriptors and reconstructed native sample timing; bind exact flags into both retained segments and source capsules.
Cold movie selection and local masked export retain independent decoder runs and exact presentation holes. Retained native decode ranges crossing a gap still refuse.
Full original replay applies even to empty, gap-only or early queries. No unselected-original integrity bypass, quota refill, timestamp repair, coverage or scene-absence inference.
normalized_model_heads: ReduceSum-13 with static optional INT64 input axes, keepdims and exact noop_with_empty_axes semantics, including omitted/empty placeholder controls.
ReduceL2-13 with static attribute axes, ordinary F32 square and ordered sum followed by the existing v2 Sqrt.
Existing operators, frozen encoding and dependency closure retained; full lowering expansion is preflighted against node, tensor, byte and work limits.
Composed weighted token pooling, L2 normalization with an explicit epsilon floor, and dense projection execute through both production executors and serialized graph/weight reload.

model.command: cargo test --locked --offline -j 1 -p fss-model-ir --test onnx_attention_execution -- --test-threads=1 --skip scalar_executor:: --skip optimized_executor::
model.filter_scope: Unrelated embedded executor unit tests; both actual production executors run in every applicable feature contract.

movie_components.scope: Actual native AVC/HEVC packet/window muxing, movie selection, independently bootstrapped decoders, selected pixel comparisons, exact timed Matroska bytes and gap-only selection. Does not execute retained custody or CLI processes.
movie_components.corrected_expectation: Raw Annex-B extraction may cross a timing gap because elementary bytes carry no timeline. The retained range barrier and separate movie decoder runs are the relevant contracts.

reference.observed_failure: rustc compiling unchanged asupersync v0.5.0 metadata was killed by signal 9/SIGKILL before project diagnostics; exit 101 after 121.23 seconds.
reference.coverage: Cold replay, exact gap markers/capture offsets, retained decoder barrier, gap-only selection, damaged unselected original, identity separation, exact authority, cumulative bounds, configuration/order/pin refusal.

cli.coverage: Distinct pure previews and approvals; catalog/page AVC/HEVC imports; cold select/export after archive disappearance; exact gapped Matroska bytes, origin reservation limits, privacy masks, unchanged originals and journals.

verification.source_review: Independent model, CLI and gap-provenance reviews found no remaining concrete defect; review is not execution.

broader_checks.policy: Repository-wide policy check did not pass: existing import/adapter/dependency-registry drift, unregistered domains and documentation links; rustup is unavailable to that audit although the exact standalone compiler is installed. No gate was weakened.
broader_checks.stable_ids: Existing QSR-OBS-COUNT-001 uses a QSR family unknown to stable_id_audit.py; no change to the stable-ID gate.

boundaries: No live camera connection, policy activation, continuous recorder or remote media delivery is added.

Gap preservation admits complete nonoverlapping native windows under one exact source/clock scope with identical initialization; it does not admit broken windows, mixed codecs or configuration changes.
Native movie/decode clocks are not UTC or proof of physical coverage. Missing footage cannot certify event absence.
Local review still requires current destination privacy screening. FLDT reviewer grants, payment-zone attestation, retained derivative custody, expiry/revocation and delivery remain open.
Model admission remains static positive-shape F32 through rank eight. L2 can overflow or underflow in ordinary F32 arithmetic; normalization floors must be explicit model operations.

ReduceMean graph lowering remains unchanged; importer implementation provenance naturally changes with the implementation. No trained-model accuracy or full RF-DETR qualification follows from fixture execution.
Broad beads remain open; no blanket feature completion or release qualification is inferred.

published_checkpoints.change: Bounded ONNX sum and L2 feature heads with 21 passing native feature contracts.
Explicit gap-preserving native catalog/page import and local timed movie review with complete original provenance.
